name: Barbarian Lethal Weapon
body:
Some barbarians rush upon their enemies swinging axes and greatswords, and some run into melee yelling and shooting their hearts out with pistols and rifles.

Shooting Fury

At 3rd level, a lethal weapon gains the Amateur Gunslinger feat. At 6th level and every four levels thereafter, the lethal weapon may choose another deed available to a gunslinger of her class level or lower to use with his Amateur Gunslinger feat in place of a rage power.

This replaces trap sense +1, +3, +4, +5, and +6.

Gritty Rage

At 6th level, a lethal weapon can fuel her rage spending grit points. Each grit point expended grants her an additional round of rage.

This replaces trap sense +2.

Rage Powers

The rage powers which complement the lethal weapon archetype are: auspicious mark, bestial leaper, boasting taunt, brawler, chaos totem, come and get me, deathless frenzy, dislodge joint, fearless rage, fueled by vengeance, furious draw, greater brawler, greater mad machinegun, intimidating glare, lesser chaos totem, lesser mad machinegun, mad machinegun, no escape, raging leaper, reckless abandon, roused anger, sprint, strength surge, swift foot, terrifying howl, unexpected strike, unrestrained rage.

Deeds: deadeye, utility shot, dead shot, and cheat death are the deeds most fit to the lethal weapon archetype.
